sections.body: Have a question about an order, fabric or delivery? Our team is happy to help.

sections.heading: Do you offer cash on delivery?
sections.body: Yes, cash on delivery is available across Pakistan.

sections.heading: How long does delivery take?
sections.body: Orders are usually delivered within 3–5 working days.

sections.heading: Is shipping free?
sections.body: Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 3,500. A flat fee applies to smaller orders.

sections.heading: Can I exchange a product?
sections.body: Yes, unused items in original packaging can be exchanged within 30 days.
Enter the order number from your confirmation message to see the latest status. Need help? Contact us on WhatsApp.
We ship nationwide through trusted courier partners.

sections.heading: Delivery time
sections.body: 3–5 working days for major cities, up to 7 working days for other areas.

sections.heading: Charges
sections.body: Free on orders above Rs. 3,500, otherwise a flat Rs. 250.
We want you to love your purchase. If something isn't right, you can request a return or exchange within 30 days of delivery.

sections.heading: Conditions
sections.body: Items must be unused, unwashed and in original packaging.

sections.heading: Damaged items
sections.body: Report any damage within 48 hours with photos and we'll arrange a replacement.
We collect only the information needed to process and deliver your orders. We never sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed through secure, PCI-compliant providers.
By using this website you agree to these terms. Prices and availability may change without notice.

sections.heading: Product colours
sections.body: Actual colours may vary slightly from images due to screen settings and lighting.
